# Fonts

The Text tool's built-in fonts (T), Regular and Bold each:

* `NotoSans-*.ttf` — Noto Sans
* `NotoSerif-*.ttf` — Noto Serif
* `NotoSansThai-*.ttf` — Noto Sans Thai (Thai letters; others come from Noto Sans)
